quality_effect: Separates determined-boundary survey precision from generic INSPIRE/general-boundary geometry.
verified_facts: A determined boundary identifies the exact line for registration purposes
Preferred plan scale is no smaller than 1:200
Measured boundary dimensions must be accurate to +/-10mm
Measurements must originate from at least two defined permanent physical features
National Grid coordinates are the accepted coordinate type
National Grid coordinates require +/-300mm absolute accuracy
National Grid coordinates require +/-10mm relative accuracy
Permanent control features should reasonably remain for at least 10 years
Determined-boundary plans must clearly identify start end and turning points
